reason: Imports historical Claude and ChatGPT memories and conversations into a local DeepSeek Harness memory store, with verbatim evidence checks and configurable human review.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude 和 ChatGPT 的历史记忆与对话导入 DeepSeek Harness 本地记忆库，并通过原文证据核对和可配置审核进行管理。
summaries.en: Imports historical Claude and ChatGPT memories and conversations into a local DeepSeek Harness memory store with verbatim evidence checks and configurable review.

capabilities: Reads local Claude Code conversation records and user-provided Claude or ChatGPT exports
Extracts memory items from conversation content using the configured model service
Sends conversation text to the configured model service for processing
Stores imported memories and evidence locally as JSONL
Supports review and approval of extracted memory items
